notes.title: Game temporarily closed
notes.content: Game is [b]temporarily closed[/b] for patch preparations.

notes.title: August Update
notes.content:
Patchnotes:

Game:

- Anticheat improvements
- A lot of environmental sounds got adjusted
- Added brightness slider in the settings
- Body no longer disappeares after death
- Better flare gun fire effects
- Better communication for when you pick up small or big ammo
- Flashlight movable in the direction you are looking at
- Fixed options for hud, motion blur and bloom
- Fixed some stairs you had to jump for 
- Gun names displayed on HUD
- Island map not in night mode anymore
- Ocean foam sticking to the beach terrain now instead of just floating on the water
- Spawn (near the radio tower in north) no longer makes you take fall damage
- SOS decal on helicopter no longer fades in & out

Menu:

- Message of the day box not clickable anymore
- 'Pre-season' leaderboard text not inside of survival rating box anymore
- Pause menu bar not  clickable anymore

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Minor Playtest server patch:

- Added  human first person arms + full body view of your player model
- Added  "IslandNoIntro" level (Which is the Island level but without the long intro,now you can play & test efficiently

notes.title: July 2023 update
notes.content:
- Added Monsters in different color variations which need 4 hits to be defeated and drop ammo
- Added a Relic monster which need 7 hits to be defeated and drops the relic you need to escape
- Anticheat for Solo/duo matchmaking 
- Base to display your trophies
- Jukebox: select your own songs for the main menu 
- Solo/duo matches dont appear in custom game server browser anymore
- The island level got optimizations
- Various small bug fixes 

- If your graphics card is capable of Nvidia RTX it will be automatically enabled in the Island level in performance mode for better FPS

notes.title: Language Hotfix
notes.content:
-Chinese & Japanese translation for the MainMenu
-Weapon positions fixed
-Helicopter pilot less annoying
-Flaregun got some new features

notes.title: Welcome EU
notes.content:
Language Patch with minor fixes

[b]-Endgame screen got fixed[/b](Now you dont need to see the same sad face again and quit)
[b]-Fall damage hurts less now[/b](Some Streamers were a bit jumpy and..we dont talk about it)
[b]-Walkietalkie sound does not blow your ears anymore[/b](Did you even talk to someone yet?)
[b]-Added a little Walkietalkie icon on the top left of the HUD[/b](ITS TAB)
[b]-Multilanguage support for the MainMenu[/b](Wurde auch Zeit, Señor)
[b]-Added a tutorial level[/b](Yo,not everyone played SOS)
[b]-Removed the Capture & Extraction markers[/b](Game is harder now,sorry)
[b]-A lot of the floating grass got removed[/b](Its okay,floating grass is not real it cant hurt you.)
[b]-Island ambience sounds are now tied to the audio settings[/b](Now you can fully mute the game Brit)
[b]-More bugs [/b](Wouldnt be an update without bugs)
